changes_vs_current: Mother's Day 11 to 3, Halloween stays 3 to 4, Fourth of July 4 to 6 (was dropped to 10 in first pass; now 6 after adding a source that includes it), Easter 6 to 5, Father's Day 14 to 7, Memorial Day 12 to 8, Valentine's 7 to 10, Veterans Day 21 to 11 (no longer above July 4), MLK 22 to 13, Super Bowl 9 to 14, St Patrick's 8 to 15, Juneteenth 19 to 16, Hanukkah 10 to 17; Lunar New Year onward (18-24) have no evidence and keep the current order.
confidence: medium for 1-15, low for 16-17, none for 18-24. Top 5 is stable across all 4 sources. Caveats: (1) YouGov 'like %' favors civic/family holidays (Memorial, Veterans, MLK, Labor) and omitted July 4 and Thanksgiving's counterpart gaps are penalized mechanically; Fourth of July is 2nd in participation and 8th in the 2024 'favorite' poll and 4th in Harris, so rank 6 is probably fair, could be 4-6. (2) The NRF source measures participation and lacks Thanksgiving (penalized 14, so Thanksgiving could be 1-2 points better). (3) Harris 2015 is old. Mother's Day at 3 comes mostly from the YouGov like% and NRF measures; in the pure 'favorite' polls (YouGov 2024, Harris) Halloween and Easter are ahead of it.
